title: HIV-1 Vpr activates the G2 checkpoint through manipulation of the ubiquitin proteasome system

grounded.context: general statement in abstract, no specific cell type given
grounded.evidence_quote: HIV-1 Vpr is a viral accessory protein that activates ATR through the induction of DNA replication stress.
Etoposide generates double-strand breaks and activates the G2 checkpoint through a combination of pathways that activate ATM, ATR and/or DNA-PK.
